cases.description: When the JSON object does not contain the "$schema" property, the method should return an empty Optional.
A recognizable schema URI is provided. After normalization the URI maps to VersionFlag.DRAFT_07, so the method returns an Optional containing that flag.
The "$schema" value is not known to SpecVersion.VersionFlag. The method should throw a JsonSchemaException with a message indicating the schema is unrecognizable.
A short form schema identifier that requires normalization. JsonSchemaFactory.normalizeMetaSchemaUri converts "draft-07" to the full URI, which is then resolved to VersionFlag.DRAFT_07.
A full meta‑schema URI for Draft‑04 is supplied; after normalization it maps to VersionFlag.DRAFT_04.
A short‑form identifier for Draft‑06 is provided; normalizeMetaSchemaUri expands it to the known URI and the method returns the corresponding flag.
The 2019‑09 meta‑schema URI is recognized and resolved to VersionFlag.DRAFT_2019_09.
The 2020‑12 meta‑schema URI is recognized and resolved to VersionFlag.DRAFT_2020_12.
An empty string is supplied for $schema; after normalization the identifier is still empty, causing an exception.
A numeric value is supplied for $schema; asText() converts it to "123", which is not a known schema URI, leading to an exception.
Explicit null is provided for $schema; NullNode.asText() yields "null", which is not a recognized schema, so an exception is thrown.
The method is invoked with a null JsonNode argument; a NullPointerException is expected because the implementation dereferences the argument without a null check.
The $schema value is a boolean true. asText() converts it to "true", which is not a known schema URI, causing a JsonSchemaException.
The $schema value is a boolean false. asText() converts it to "false", leading to an unrecognizable schema exception.
The $schema value is an array. asText() yields the JSON array representation, which does not match any known schema URI, resulting in a JsonSchemaException.
The $schema value consists only of whitespace. After normalization the identifier remains blank, causing an exception.
The root node is an array; get("$schema") returns null, so the method should return an empty Optional.
